title: plugin-approvals: an approval delegation with no organization still applies across every tenant (the retired NULL-means-global reading, ADR-0131)
body:
Filing gate **③**: an observation of the contract review of PR #25266 (record 6348535486, observation 3), disposed in the seat's ACCEPT 6348614791 (item 5). PR #25266 retired the NULL-means-global texts on `sys_user_position` and `sys_user_permission_set`; this one is outside its card (#25203).
- **Who acts:** `domain:services`.
- **Dedupe:** none found.

Part of #15212.

## What happens on `main` (at `bda53bb0b`)
- ADR-0131 retires "NULL organization means every organization": a grant applies only while its organization is the active one, and an organization-less grant applies nowhere (`grantAppliesInTenant`, `packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts`).
- `sys_approval_delegation` still reads the old way, in code and in text:
  - `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts:3245`: the active-delegation filter keeps a row when `r.organization_id == null` ("A null-org rule applies across tenants"), and also when the caller's `organizationId == null`.
  - `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-delegation.object.ts:143`: the help says "null = applies across tenants for this delegator", and the `en` / `es-ES` / `ja-JP` bundles carry it (`translations/*.objects.generated.ts:377`).
- Whether an organization-less delegation row can still be written under a wall (D9 stamps a system insert) decides how reachable the cross-tenant reading is; the card measures it.

## Wanted
- Decide the delegation's reading under ADR-0131 the way `grantAppliesInTenant` does (an organization-less delegation applies nowhere under a wall; the single-organization posture as ADR-0131 says), in the one filter at `:3245`.
- The object help and its bundles say what the code does (regenerate `en` with the repo tool; update the hand-written locales).

## Acceptance
- Pinned: under a wall, a delegation of organization A does not reroute an approval in organization B, and an organization-less row reroutes nothing; the same-organization delegation still applies.
- `Clause-②` / `Metadata-protocol` declared per AGENTS.md.
